name: SVG viewer
description: Shows SVG and SVGZ pictures, and their source coloured as XML.

codes.01a15a31-bee0-72a5-bbbf-292cb2295623.too: The SVG is larger than 64 MiB, or unpacks to more.
codes.01a15a31-bee0-72a5-bbbf-292cb2295623.bad: The compressed SVG (.svgz) is damaged and cannot be unpacked.
codes.01a15a31-bee0-72a5-bbbf-292cb2295623.not: The picture cannot be drawn: the file is not a readable SVG, or it has no size.
codes.01a15a31-bee0-72a5-bbbf-292cb2295623.too: The picture repeats its parts (<use>) too often to be drawn.
